intro: St. Louis's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $108/month (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the St. Louis metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $103, up 4.5% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $115. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $42 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$45.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $64 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$70. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $108 (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats St. Louis metro non-climate asking rent $103, up 4.5% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not St. Louis alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$115.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $142 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$155.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $179 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$212.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Downtown West Saint Louis (~$77), Dutchtown (~$91), Tower Grove South (~$94) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. The Hill (~$136) is among the highest.
St. Louis has about 58 facilities and 4.8 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
